segments.title: Gemini keeps a file on you
segments.say: Gemini now shows the file it keeps on you. Here's how to read it.

segments.title: 5 folders about you
segments.say: It's called Memory summary: what Gemini knows about you, in five folders.

segments.title: Where to find it
segments.say: On the web: Settings, then Personal Intelligence.

segments.title: Delete what you don't want
segments.say: Type what to remove, and Memory history shows when each fact was saved.

segments.title: Who gets it now
segments.say: For now: Google AI subscribers, US English, web first.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to the friend who tells Gemini everything, and follow Nexora.
